t: Paulet Wilquet Alias Hector O.P. Wilquet Alias Tango Reno, Impostor Who Claims To Be Peruvian Representative In Shanghai

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. 7880
29th, 37
Date April 19, 1937.

Subject Paulet Wilquet alias Hector O.P. Wilquet alias Tango Reno,
impostor who claims to be Peruvian representative in Shanghai.
Made by D.P.S. Henchman Forwarded by Iboyu DSS

Paulet Wilquet alias Hector O. P. Wilquet alias Tango
Reno came to Shanghai in September of 1935, travelling from
Kobe via Peiping; he was accompanied by his wife, Fukuko, a
Japanese. He was born in Lima, Peru, in 1910 and subsequent-
ly joined his father who was Peruvian representative at Kobe.
As a member of the Peruvian Consulate Wilquet was granted a
diplomatic passport. In 1934, against his father's wish, he
married a Japanese and in 1935, his father having disowned
him, he came to Shanghai where he endeavoured to establish
himself as Peruvian representative. The Consular Body
however, owing to his lack of credentials, refused to recognise
him. Since that time Wilquet, making use of his diplomatic
passport and the fact that Peruvians in Shanghai enjoy extra-
territorial rights, has defrauded various people for a number
of small sums. He has also earned money by painting pictures,
for he is something of an artist. Recently he opened an
account, with a small sum, at the National City Bank of New
York and the following are among the people and concerns whom
he has given cheques which the Bank has refused to honour:-
Embassy Hotel............$74 (12.4.37)
Jessfield Club...........$35
Mr. Zee of Allman
Davis, Hamilton House....$60
Central Mansions
(Apt. House).............$100
Wilquet's last address was the Embassy Hotel, Bubbling Well
Road; he removed on 11.4.37 and his present whereabouts are
unknown.

特务科第一股
报告
档案号 7880
29日，37年
日期：1937年4月19日。

事由：Paulet Wilquet，化名 Hector O.P. Wilquet，又名 Tango Reno，冒充秘鲁驻上海代表之骗子。
制作人：D.P.S. Henchman 转呈人：Iboyu DSS

Paulet Wilquet，化名 Hector O. P. Wilquet，又名 Tango Reno，于1935年9月经由北平从神户抵达上海；随行有其妻 Fukuko，系日本人。他于1910年出生于秘鲁利马，随后投奔其父，其父当时任秘鲁驻神户代表。作为秘鲁领事馆成员，Wilquet 获发外交护照。1934年，他不顾父亲意愿与一名日本女子结婚；1935年，因其父与其断绝关系，他来到上海，试图确立自己为秘鲁代表的身份。然而，领事团因其缺乏凭证，拒绝承认其身份。自此以后，Wilquet 利用其外交护照以及秘鲁人在上海享有治外法权这一事实，诈骗多人小额款项。他也通过作画赚钱，因为他颇具艺术才华。最近，他在纽约国家城市银行（National City Bank of New York）开立账户，存入少量资金，以下是他开具支票但被银行拒付的部分个人及商号：
Embassy Hotel（使馆饭店）............74美元（1937年4月12日）
Jessfield Club（兆丰公园俱乐部/极司菲尔俱乐部）...........35美元
Allman Davis, Hamilton House 的 Zee 先生....60美元
Central Mansions（中央公寓）.............100美元
Wilquet 最后的住址是静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）的 Embassy Hotel（使馆饭店）；他于1937年4月11日搬离，目前下落不明。
Wilquet 非常渴望返回秘鲁，并已

approached, unsuccessfully, various Consular authorities
with requests for help. He has been advised, however, to
approach the Peruvian Representative at Hongkong and it is
expected that he will leave Shanghai in the very near future.
A description of Wilquet is herewith appended:-
Age: 27.
Height: 5' 5"
Complexion: Dark.
Hair: Dark.
Build: Medium, wide shoulders.
Clean shaven, limps slightly, smartly dressed.
Because there is no Peruvian representative, it should
be noted that although Peruvians are entitled to extra-
territorial rights in Shanghai, Wilquet, if charged, would
be brought before the Chinese Court.
